recentPreviews.title: LityOS phone v2 PR 4: rounded output and black backdrop
recentPreviews.summary:
Phone mode only (APK, no image change):
• The guest SurfaceView (inside the PR 2 margins) gets rounded corners, default 28 dp, via ViewOutlineProvider + clipToOutline. Chosen over any offscreen/per-frame work: the clip is applied by the compositor on the surface layer, so no per-frame cost in the app on the software-rendered Z Flip 7. The radius is capped to half the short side.
• Black sessionRoo
